title: M2 自动化验收结果
claim_scope: 固定开发测试项的通过数，不是学生或学习效果数据

data_source.interpretation: Frozen M2 acceptance record: focused 82 items are included in the 309 Python regression items; the 5 CLI tests are a separate Node.js suite. Release-validation results are recorded separately.

generator.locale_warnings: Windows R startup emitted four non-fatal warnings because C.UTF-8 could not be set for LC_COLLATE, LC_CTYPE, LC_MONETARY, and LC_TIME.

notes: Static preflight retains its basic-syntax warning; actual R parse(file=...) succeeded.
No journal-specific output width is configured because F06 is an internal experiment report.

png_visual_review.findings: Final-size PNG labels, bars and margins show no visible clipping or overlap.

pdf_text_audit.notes: Generic content-stream scan sees Cairo text at 1 pt. PyMuPDF spans show 8.82–13 pt and all 14 spans remain inside the page; trace bounds are expanded for transformed glyphs. The generic audit discrepancy is retained for review.

pdf_collision_audit.notes: Cairo trace geometry expands text boxes, producing 7 FAIL and 1 WARN despite clean full-size PNG review. The scanner report is preserved and not marked passed.

limitations: The plotted M2 results are the frozen 82/309/5 engineering acceptance record; current v0.6.2 release regressions are reported as a separate run.
Focused tests are included in the Python regression count and must not be added to it.
Cairo PDF content-stream text and collision scans disagree with extracted visible text bounds and the visual render; the generic collision result remains needs_review.
